design: Two independent 80000-sample IMA-ADPCM WAV chunks, each40x1024 payload bytes plus header/pending/state
While encrypting or writing frozen chunk, cooperative progress callback drains PCM queue into second chunk only
Callback must not call filesystem, RNG, USB ownership transition, or recursively save; latch errors and unwind outer writer
Invoke progress in SD busy polling and bounded transfer boundaries; crypto CPU duration separately must fit PCM queue
On staging chunk full while previous still saving: explicit overrun; never overwrite unsaved samples
Keep file naming, encryption, power-fail recovery and host decoding compatibility; 36h increases full chunks from12960 to25920 and requires repeated capacity/recovery testing
limits: Five-second staging is finite; exact card remains unqualified
Static stack screen has missing frames and is not an upper-bound proof
No measured energy savings; twice the per-file setup rate versus10s legacy
Crypto before the storage callback must fit remaining PCM queue time
